notes.title: 3.0.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p][b][u]Improved UI and full Japanese voice acting coming on October 8th![/u][/b][/p][p]A big hello from Team Tetrapod. Thank you all for the continued interest and support. We're excited to announce a new update based on all the feedback we've gathered from our fans. Please check out all the changes coming with this new update![/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Full Japanese voice acting and an increase in price[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/a5a6f93c3ae0a679d2d0866e1e3177361f0a485f.png"][/img][/p][p]The full Japanese voice acting, added first to the Nintendo Switch™ editions of Staffer Case and Staffer Reborn, is now coming to Steam for fans of the series to enjoy.[/p][p]Start your second playthrough with our talented voice actors and actresses, adding that much more immersion to the game.✨[/p][p]This update will drop on October 8th, 2025, at 10:00 AM Korean Standard Time (1:00 AM GMT).
Players who have already purchased the game before the update can enjoy this updated full voice addition for free.[/p][p]The Japanese voice dubbing was originally a perk applied to the Nintendo Switch™ version only, but due to fan requests and a few new contracts, we've obtained a license to add it to the Steam version.  
In order to make the PC and Nintendo Switch™ prices the same, the price of the Steam version of Staffer Case will be increased by $5.00 USD after the update. (Staffer Reborn will increase in price by $2.00 USD)[/p][p]Players planning to buy the game should make full use of this discount![/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Improved UI visibility and useability[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/4ad87d232e94f20e50882241a5fb4b59ebbe4353.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/6b902d4e520705ce7c35d09c0e01b160abff9874.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/556e6d19898b385dd21f5f174bc65d06c33a85a3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Controls adapted to console for ease of use now mean it's easier to play with Xbox control schemes.[/p][/*][*][p]Due to the feedback about small screen sizes (laptops, etc.) making the game hard to read and thus difficult to play, we've adjusted the size of settings menus, reasoning mode, and other text, modifying some of the UI layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now see their cursor easier on-screen in reasoning mode, signaling clickable clues in the area with a color change so that players can find them easier.[/p][/*][*][p]The story mode interface has been improved, making it all more visible and readable.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue logbook UI has been drastically improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Save / Load UI design has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]3. Backgrounds swapped[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/f6b0482b0a6185f6ca31d9e9c122c297dc386c99.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/03854fca85ef76dc8978e4436b56bdc8e6ff021c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/dd35e5818878d90908c9af73d0de37ea419ca0ce.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Retouched some of the in-game background images to improve their quality.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Replaced lower-resolution images with higher-resolution images.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]4. Bug fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed small typos and awkward phrasing in certain places.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary buttons in reasoning mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the game files for better performance on more devices.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Dice Eater Released! and Special STAFFER Series Korean Vocal EP Out Now!
notes.content: [h1]Dice Eater Officially Released![/h1][p]Hello from Team Tetrapod![/p][p]As of July 1st at midnight(KST), [b]Dice Eater[/b]—the third title and second spin-off of the STAFFER series—is now officially available![/p][p]This first half of the year has been filled with new ideas and bold challenges. We've carefully incorporated your valuable feedback during the Early Access period, and we're pleased to finally present the official release.[/p][p]To celebrate and show our appreciation for your patience and support, we're excited to share a special Korean vocal EP from the STAFFER series—[b]"Chasm of Lies."[/b] This EP captures the essence and storytelling of the STAFFER universe.[/p][p]Thank you for your continuous support, and stay tuned for even more exciting content from us soon! ✨[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2CWzqWejVb4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360110/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 세이브 파일 호환 관련 & 업데이트 사전 공지
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884809/767c445663faa491cc655c90856ae1698209aa65.png[/img]

스테퍼 케이스를 플레이해주시는 여러분 반갑습니다.
2주 후인 4월 26일에 있을 대규모 업데이트와 관련한 소식을 공지드립니다.
자세한 안내 사항을 말씀드리기 전에, [b]4월 26일 이전의 세이브 파일은 이후 버전과 호환되지 않을 가능성이 있음을 알려드립니다.[/b]
이는 스테퍼 케이스가 스팀 클라우드 지원하면서 발생하게 된 문제로, 혹시 아직 진행 중인 케이스가 있다면, 4월 26일 업데이트 전에 클리어해주시기를 바랍니다. 

[h3]본론으로 돌아와서, 4월 26일에 진행되는 업데이트 내용은 다음과 같습니다.[/h3]

- 추가 언어 지원: 영어, 일본어, 중국어 간체, 중국어 번체 

-인터페이스 개편

-mac os 지원

-트레이딩 카드 추가

-각종 버그 수정

[h3]업데이트와 별개이지만, 4월 26일에는 스테퍼 케이스의 스핀오프인 [스테퍼 리본]이 출시하는 날이기도 합니다.
많은 관심 부탁드립니다.[/h3]
